metadata.gsd_note: Reference nadir GSD at vertical height; use per-target directional GSD for oblique geometry.
metadata.projection: ideal perspective, square pixels, zero distortion, no aperture offset
metadata.image_coordinates: top-left edge origin; pixel centers at (column+0.5,row+0.5)
metadata.pose_convention: Engineering only: pitch tilts optical axis toward world -Z from nadir; positive roll rotates camera right toward unrolled up. Not PI HiDef convention.
metadata.randomisation: none; deterministic geometry, RGB not guaranteed bitwise deterministic
metadata.capture_projection_source: Authored USD camera frustum, matching full-image aspect and square pixels; not the UI projection
metadata.matrix_convention: USD/Gf row-vector world * view * projection; NDC x/y [-1,1], image origin top-left
metadata.ui_projection_note: ViewportAPI.projection describes the UI element; never use as capture-image intrinsics
metadata.actual_matrix_alias_note: Version 2: aliases for capture-camera matrices; version 1 stored UI matrices
metadata.hdr_domain: Native HdrColor float AOV; absolute radiometric calibration unverified
metadata.renderer_settings_scope: Legacy globals before isolated viewport setup; effective_settings.json records the actual USD camera/product controls
